label: Gear
description: What I carry, with weights, and how I pack it.

settings.heading: What I carry
settings.standfirst: Everything I travel and work with, after three years of taking things out of the bag.

settings.heading: How I pack
settings.body:
Cubes by use, not by type: one for work, one for clothes, one for the things that charge. The laptop rides against my back, and the rain shell sits on top where I can reach it without unpacking.

If something has not come out of the bag in two stops, it goes home in a box.
